scene_timeline.visual_description: The word 'AI' is overlaid on a distorted, upside-down human face with glowing eyes.
A hand touches the Apple logo on a laptop, then transitions to a hand brushing through real green grass.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Voiceover: 'I was meant to be new.'

scene_timeline.visual_description: Split-screen showing two different individuals placing their hands over their hearts/chests.
A rapid montage of four different faces, including one that appears to be a red, liquid-metal humanoid.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Voiceover: 'I was meant to be beautiful.'

scene_timeline.visual_description: An elderly woman looks off-camera, followed by a shot of the creator with digital tracking lines overlaid on his face.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Voiceover: 'We used to say that seeing is believing and that's no longer the case.'

scene_timeline.visual_description: Split-screen: the creator at a professional editing desk vs. a man in 'ICE' tactical gear waving a hand to block a camera.
Split-screen: hands typing on a keyboard vs. Donald Trump walking with an aide, followed by a priest in a church as a ghostly figure of an old man appears behind him.
A black screen with small white text asking a philosophical question.

parsed_output.overall_summary: This video is a cinematic and thought-provoking commentary on the blurring lines between reality and artificial intelligence. Through a series of split-screens and montages, the creator contrasts physical sensations like touching grass with digital interfaces and AI-generated imagery. The central message, reinforced by both voiceover and text, is that visual evidence can no longer be trusted as absolute truth in the age of deepfakes and advanced AI generation.

people.description: The creator, a young man with glasses, shown working at a computer and with digital tracking overlays.
Former US President walking in a suit.
A man wearing a black beanie and a green tactical vest labeled 'ICE' and 'POLICE'.

entities.name: I Was Meant to Be New
entities.display_name: I Was Meant to Be New - Abram Shaffer

takeaways.statement: The traditional adage 'seeing is believing' is no longer valid due to the capabilities of AI.
AI is rapidly integrating into and distorting our perception of the physical world.
